title: Object-Centric World Models for Causality-Aware Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.14262v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models have been developed to support sample-efficient deep reinforcement learning agents. However, it remains challenging for world models to accurately replicate environments that are high-dimensional, non-stationary, and composed of multiple objects with rich interactions since most world models learn holistic representations of all environmental components. By contrast, humans perceive the environment by decomposing it into discrete objects, facilitating efficient decision-making. Motivated by this insight, we propose \emph{Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning} (STICA), a unified framework in which object-centric Transformers serve as the world model and causality-aware policy and value networks. translated_title: 面向因果感知强化学习的以对象为中心的世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型已被开发用于支持样本高效的深度强化学习智能体。然而，由于大多数世界模型学习的是所有环境组件的整体表示，世界模型难以准确复现那些高维、非平稳、且由具有丰富交互的多个对象组成的环境。相比之下，人类通过将环境分解为离散的对象来感知环境，从而实现高效决策。受这一洞察的启发，我们提出了STICA（Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning，基于槽位Transformer想象与因果感知强化学习），这是一个统一框架，其中以对象为中心的Transformer既充当世界模型，也充当因果感知的策略网络与价值网络。STICA将每个观测表示为一组以对象为中心的token，同时包含智能体动作及其产生的奖励的token，使世界模型能够在token级别上预测环境动态……
tldr: 该论文提出STICA统一框架，利用以对象为中心的Transformer作为世界模型，并配合因果感知的策略与价值网络，使强化学习智能体能够像人类一样分解复杂多对象环境，从而实现更高效的样本学习与决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STICA, a unified framework that employs object-centric Transformers as world models together with causality-aware policy and value networks, enabling reinforcement learning agents to decompose complex multi-object environments for more efficient and effective decision-making.
